## Professional Ventures & Core Track
1. **Dabbirha AI & Workflow Automation Agency:**
   Jordan's pioneer startup dedicated to bespoke enterprise workflow automation and Autonomous AI Agents, eliminating friction and transforming manual operations into self-driving business cycles using generative AI, Python, SQL, and Power BI.
2. **Sovereign Earth (24/7 Web & Cloud MMORPG):**
   A geopolitical strategy and open-market economy MMORPG simulating global supply chain dynamics across 7 sovereign continents, powered by an in-game Google Gemini AI crisis advisor.
3. **Cognitive Prototyping (Vibe Coding) & Web Operations:**
   Rapid MVP product development, enterprise WordPress platforms, and advanced Technical SEO leveraging Google Search Console and cognitive UX psychology.
4. **Financial Systems & Database Administration (FACT & Banking Systems):**
   Resolving complex database issues, auditing data security, and ensuring compliance for enterprise banking applications and institutional systems.
5. **Executive Leadership & Commercial Operations (5+ Years):**
   Distinguished leadership track across major commercial operations, sales restructuring, and high-level enterprise supply chain architecture.
